Structure

Source: vignettes/structure.Rmd
structure.Rmd

nemo has three base R6 classes: Config, Tool, Workflow. Child packages (tidywigits, tidydragen) subclass Tool/Workflow with tool-specific parsers and tidiers.

Examples below use the built-in Tool1 and Workflow1.

Config

Reads inst/config/tools/<tool>/schema.yaml and serves versioned raw/tidy schemas from it. See ?Config.

One tables entry per output file:

tables:
  <table_name>:
    description: '<human-readable description>'
    pattern: "<regex matching the file basename>"
    glob: ["<aws s3 sync --include glob>", '...']
    ftype: '<file type — see below>'
    columns:
      - raw: '<raw column name or positional label>'
        tidy: '<tidy snake_case name>'
        type: 'char | int | float'
        description: '<human-readable description>'
        versions: ['<version1>', '<version2>']
  • pattern: PCRE regex on the file basename; Tool uses it to discover and classify local files.
  • glob: list of aws s3 sync --include patterns on the whole key; wf_sync_patterns() collects them to decide what to sync down. Usually the basename pattern with a leading * ("\\.tool1\\.table1\\.tsv$" => ["*.tool1.table1.tsv"]).

ftype picks the parser:

ftype Description raw: names Parser
tsv Header present; tab-delimited actual column names parse_file
csv Header present; comma-delimited actual column names parse_file (delim=,)
tsv-nohead No header; positional columns X1, X2, …, XN parse_file_nohead
tsv-keyvalue No header; 2 cols (key, value); pivoted wide actual key values parse_file_keyvalue

Child packages add ftypes by overriding private$extra_ftypes() (named list of ftype -> function(x, table_name)).

versions lists every tool version a column appears in:

# table1 columns
SampleID:   versions: ['v1.2.3', 'v4.5.6', 'latest']  # present in all versions
metricX:    versions: ['v1.2.3']                        # dropped in v4.5.6
metricY:    versions: ['latest']                        # added in latest

Schema for version V = columns whose versions contain V. schema_guess matches a file’s columns to the right version.

tool <- params$tool
workflow <- params$workflow
conf <- nemo::Config$new(tool, pkg = "nemo")
conf
## #--- Config nemo::tool1 ---#
## 
## |var   |value |
## |:-----|:-----|
## |tool  |tool1 |
## |pkg   |nemo  |
## |ntbls |5     |

All tables:

conf$get_patterns() |> knitr::kable(caption = glue("{tool} patterns."))
Tool1 patterns.
name pattern
table1 .tool1.table1.tsv$
table2 .tool1.table2.tsv$
table3 .tool1.table3.tsv$
table4 .tool1.table4.tsv$
table6 .tool1.table6.csv$ 
conf$get_globs() |> knitr::kable(caption = glue("{tool} globs."))
Tool1 globs.
name glob
table1 *.tool1.table1.tsv
table2 *.tool1.table2.tsv
table3 *.tool1.table3.tsv
table4 *.tool1.table4.tsv
table6 *.tool1.table6.csv 
conf$get_ftypes() |> knitr::kable(caption = glue("{tool} file types."))
Tool1 file types.
name ftype
table1 tsv
table2 tsv
table3 tsv-keyvalue
table4 tsv-nohead
table6 csv 
conf$get_descriptions() |> knitr::kable(caption = glue("{tool} descriptions."))
Tool1 descriptions.
name description
table1 Table1 for tool1 (tsv: header present, tab-delimited).
table2 Table2 for tool1 (tsv: header present, tab-delimited).
table3 Table3 for tool1 (tsv-keyvalue: no header, 2 cols, col1=key col2=value).
table4 Table4 for tool1 (tsv-nohead: no header, positional cols X1..XN).
table6 Table6 for tool1 (csv: header present, comma-delimited).

One table:

conf$get_pattern("table1")
## [1] "\\.tool1\\.table1\\.tsv$"
conf$get_ftype("table1")
## [1] "tsv"
conf$get_description("table1")
## [1] "Table1 for tool1 (tsv: header present, tab-delimited)."

One table, one version:

conf$get_schema_raw("table1", version = "v1.2.3")

## 4 v1.2.3  End        i    
## 5 v1.2.3  metricX    d
conf$get_schema_tidy("table1", version = "v1.2.3")

##   <chr>   <chr>      <chr>
## 1 v1.2.3  sample_id  c    
## 2 v1.2.3  chromosome c

## 4 v1.2.3  end        i

Raw-to-tidy column map, for use in tidy_* methods:

conf$get_col_map("table6")
## # A tibble: 4 × 4
##   raw      tidy      type  description    
##   <chr>    <chr>     <chr> <chr>          
## 1 GeneId   gene_id   c     Ensembl gene ID
## 2 GeneName gene_name c     gene name      
## 3 AdjTPM   tpm_adj   d     adjusted TPM   
## 4 RawTPM   tpm_raw   d     raw TPM

Tool

Finds, parses, tidies and writes one tool’s files. See ?Tool.

tool1_path <- system.file("extdata/tool1", package = "nemo")
t1 <- nemo::Tool1$new(path = tool1_path)
# each class comes with a print function
t1
## #--- Tool nemo::tool1 ---#
## 
## |var     |value                                                                     |
## |:-------|:-------------------------------------------------------------------------|
## |name    |tool1                                                                     |
## |path    |/home/runner/miniconda3/envs/pkgdown_env/lib/R/library/nemo/extdata/tool1 |
## |files   |11                                                                        |
## |tidied  |false                                                                     |
## |written |false                                                                     |
t1$config
## #--- Config nemo::tool1 ---#
## 
## |var   |value |
## |:-----|:-----|
## |tool  |tool1 |
## |pkg   |nemo  |
## |ntbls |5     |
t1$config$get_patterns()
## # A tibble: 5 × 2
##   name   pattern                   
##   <chr>  <chr>                     
## 1 table1 "\\.tool1\\.table1\\.tsv$"
## 2 table2 "\\.tool1\\.table2\\.tsv$"
## 3 table3 "\\.tool1\\.table3\\.tsv$"
## 4 table4 "\\.tool1\\.table4\\.tsv$"
## 5 table6 "\\.tool1\\.table6\\.csv$"
t1$config$get_schema_raw("table1", version = "v1.2.3")
## # A tibble: 5 × 3
##   version field      type 
##   <chr>   <chr>      <chr>
## 1 v1.2.3  SampleID   c    
## 2 v1.2.3  Chromosome c    
## 3 v1.2.3  Start      i    
## 4 v1.2.3  End        i    
## 5 v1.2.3  metricX    d
# t1$config$get_schema_raw("table1", version = "latest") # default
t1$config$get_schema_tidy("table1", version = "v1.2.3")

##   version field      type 
##   <chr>   <chr>      <chr>

lf <- t1$list_files()
lf |> dplyr::slice(1) |> str()
## tibble [1 × 9] (S3: tbl_df/tbl/data.frame)

##  $ parser       : chr "table1"
##  $ bname        : chr "sampleA.tool1.table1.tsv"
##  $ size         : 'fs_bytes' num 133
##  $ lastmodified : POSIXct[1:1], format: "2026-10-05 07:22:11"

##  $ prefix       : chr "sampleA"
##  $ prefix_suffix: chr ""

tidy() modifies the object in place:

# this will create a new field tbls containing the tidy data (and optionally
# the 'raw' parsed data)
t1$tidy(keep_raw = TRUE)
tbls <- t1$get_tbls()
tbls

Keep/drop tool_parsers with include/exclude:

# create new Tool1 object
t2 <- nemo::Tool1$new(path = tool1_path)
t2$list_files()
## # A tibble: 11 × 9
##    tool_parser  parser bname             size lastmodified        path  pattern prefix prefix_suffix
##    <chr>        <chr>  <chr>            <fs:> <dttm>              <chr> <chr>   <chr>  <chr>

Formats: parquet, db, tsv, csv, rds. Optional input_id, output_id and input_prefix (prefix_include = TRUE) columns get prepended. See output naming.

t2$tidy() # first need to tidy
outdir1 <- file.path(tempdir(), "tool1_write")
fmt <- "csv"
t2$write(
  output_dir = outdir1,
  format = fmt,
  input_id = "run123",
  output_id = "out123",
  prefix_include = TRUE
)
wfiles <- fs::dir_info(outdir1) |>
  dplyr::mutate(bname = basename(.data$path)) |>
  dplyr::select("bname", "size", "type")
wfiles
## # A tibble: 5 × 3
##   bname                                size type 
##   <chr>                         <fs::bytes> <fct>
## 1 metadata_tool1.parquet              4.74K file 
## 2 sampleA_2_tool1_table2.csv.gz          83 file 
## 3 sampleA_2_tool1_table3.csv.gz          98 file 
## 4 sampleA_tool1_table2.csv.gz            99 file 
## 5 sampleA_tool1_table3.csv.gz           111 file

run() = filter + tidy + write:

t3 <- nemo::Tool1$new(path = tool1_path)
outdir2 <- file.path(tempdir(), "t3")
t3$list_files()
## # A tibble: 11 × 9
##    tool_parser  parser bname             size lastmodified        path  pattern prefix prefix_suffix
##    <chr>        <chr>  <chr>            <fs:> <dttm>              <chr> <chr>   <chr>  <chr>

Workflow

A list of Tools with the same list_files/filter_files/tidy/write/run API, plus get_tools(). Workflow1 wraps a single Tool1. See ?Workflow.

w <- system.file("extdata/tool1", package = "nemo") |>
  nemo::Workflow1$new()
outdir3 <- file.path(tempdir(), "w1")
w$get_tools()
## $tool1
## #--- Tool nemo::tool1 ---#
## 
## |var     |value     |
## |:-------|:---------|
## |name    |tool1     |
## |path    |<ignored> |
## |files   |11        |
## |tidied  |false     |
## |written |false     |
w$list_files()
## # A tibble: 11 × 10
##    tool  tool_parser  parser bname       size lastmodified        path  pattern prefix prefix_suffix

x <- w$run(
  output_dir = outdir3,
  format = "tsv",
  input_id = "wf1_run1",
  output_id = "out1",
  prefix_include = TRUE
)
wfiles3 <- fs::dir_info(outdir3) |>
  dplyr::select(1:5) |>
  dplyr::mutate(bname = basename(.data$path))

  dplyr::select("bname", "size", "type")

Metadata

Workflow$write()/$run() (non-db formats) also write a single-row metadata.parquet: IDs, paths, pkg versions, files written.

meta <- arrow::read_parquet(file.path(outdir3, "metadata.parquet"))
meta |> dplyr::glimpse()
## Rows: 1
## Columns: 6
## $ input_id     <chr> "wf1_run1"
## $ output_id    <chr> "out1"
## $ input_dirs   <list<character>> "/home/runner/miniconda3/envs/pkgdown_env/lib/R/library/nemo/extdata/tool1"…
## $ output_dir   <chr> "/tmp/RtmpRGzZ7M/w1"
## $ pkg_versions <list<
##   tbl_df<
##     name   : character
##     version: character
##   >
## >> [<tbl_df[1 x 2]>]
## $ files        <list<
##   tbl_df<
##     tbl   : character
##     prefix: character
##     fout  : character
##     fin   : character
##   >
## >> [<tbl_df[11 x 4]>]…

Unnest list columns:

meta |> dplyr::select("pkg_versions") |> tidyr::unnest("pkg_versions")
## # A tibble: 1 × 2
##   name  version   
##   <chr> <chr>     
## 1 nemo  0.1.0.9007
